landing_hero_intro_description: Create work orders, register assets, define procedures and schedule your team from a single platform.
landing_wo_title: Every job, its technician, its status, its history.
landing_wo_p1: When one work order lives in an email, another in WhatsApp and another in the coordinator's head, things slip through. The technician arrives without the information they need and the supervisor can't say with certainty where the day's work stands.
landing_wo_p2: Create, assign and close work orders from a single screen. Every team member, from coordinator to field tech, sees the same status, the same history, the same notes. No forwarding, no double entries, no asking in chat.
landing_pm_p1: When preventive maintenance doesn't run, equipment fails in production. And when it fails in production, the cost multiplies tenfold. But remembering every date, on every asset, for every technician, doesn't scale with a growing team.
landing_pm_p2: Define the recurrence once: by fixed date or by equipment usage hours. forgecmms creates the work orders at the exact moment, assigns them to the responsible technician and keeps a record of everything that was done.
landing_section_assets_title: The complete history of every piece of equipment.
landing_section_assets_p1: When an asset fails and no one knows when its last service was, someone has to dig through papers, old emails or the head of a technician who is no longer at the company. Every minute searching is a minute the machine is down.
landing_section_assets_p2: Every piece of equipment has a living record: when it came in, what has been done to it, which parts were replaced, how many hours it has run. When someone needs it, whether in the office or in front of the asset, it's there in seconds.
landing_section_scheduling_title: Your team knows what to do every day.
landing_section_scheduling_p1: Without clear scheduling, technicians arrive at the start of the day asking what they should do. Urgencies take over, preventive work gets postponed, and at the end of the month no one really knows where the team's time went.
landing_section_scheduling_p2: Scheduling should be a map, not a to-do list. Assign from the calendar, move blocks between technicians when priorities change, and every team member opens the app and sees exactly what they have to do, where, and when.
landing_section_procedures_title: The same process, executed the same way every time.
landing_section_procedures_p1: The same job, done by two different technicians, shouldn't have two different outcomes. But it happens every day: one forgets a step, another does an extra check, and the customer gets inconsistent service that erodes trust.
landing_section_procedures_p2: Define the procedure once, with its steps, required photos and signatures, and apply it to any work order. The technician doesn't improvise: they complete what is there, in the order it is in, and everything is recorded for audit or for the next person to touch the equipment.
landing_mobile_p1: The technician shouldn't open email, check WhatsApp or ask the supervisor what they have to do today. All that friction translates into hours lost before starting the first job.
landing_mobile_p2: Every technician opens the app and sees their day's schedule, the asset's data, the photos from the last service and the procedure steps. If they lose signal, everything keeps working and syncs when they're back online.
landing_mobile_capture_p1: If the work was done but wasn't recorded, then for the customer it wasn't done. And for the next technician who touches the asset, neither.
landing_mobile_capture_p2: Every step of the procedure is completed in the app, with the required photo, the customer's signature and the exact time. When the technician closes the work order, everything goes into the asset's history, ready for audit or for the next visit.
landing_faq_a1: Yes. Start with the free plan and upgrade when you need the paid features.
landing_faq_q2: How many users can I add?
landing_faq_a2: Unlimited. Every plan includes unlimited backoffice users and field technicians. Pricing does not scale per user.
landing_faq_q3: What platforms does forgecmms run on?
landing_faq_a3: A web app for backoffice users in any modern browser, and the same application installed on the phone as a PWA for field technicians. It runs on Android and on iPhone.
landing_faq_q4: What user roles does forgecmms support?
landing_faq_a4: Two roles: backoffice users (managers, planners, anyone working from a computer) and field technicians (the people executing work in the field on the mobile app).
landing_faq_q5: What languages is forgecmms available in?
landing_faq_a5: English, Spanish (neutral Latin American), and Brazilian Portuguese — the same application on the computer and on the phone, end to end.
landing_faq_q6: What can field technicians do on the mobile app?
landing_faq_a6: Open the work assigned to them, follow the attached procedure step by step (text, numbers, multiple choice, photos, signatures), capture evidence photos in the field, and close the job with a signature. The interface is focused on the day's assigned work — no extra noise.

landing_hero_oss_note: Apache 2.0, and the compose file brings up the whole stack.
landing_faq_q7: Can I run forgecmms on my own server?
landing_faq_a7: Yes. Clone the repository, copy .env.example to .env, and run docker compose up -d --build. That starts PostgreSQL, MinIO, Caddy with the certificates, the web process and the job worker. The first account you create also creates the organization. The license is Apache 2.0 and billing is disabled by default, so every feature is available.
